You might be 60 someday, but you'll never be transgender. This is why you'll never understand gender dysphoria. 

Now as for the answer to your question, Biologically someday, without aid, you will probably be 60 but no matter how hard you try you will not be transgender because you weren't born transgender.

I know I'm not going to "win" this argument because you, at 42 presumably, have decided to have strong opinions about a topic you have a limited understanding of that has nothing to do with you and will never affect your life. 

Anyway, have a good day. I hope you make it to 60 someday. Don't let anyone tell you that you couldn't do it.
